dedupe_keys.name: france communal heat and cold consumption

description: SDES publishes annual heat and cold deliveries and delivery-point counts by activity sector and network. The description also identifies installed capacity, annual production, carbon content and cogeneration contributions. The provider is SDES. Coverage: The collection covers France from 2018, using the commune where each network is located. Annual totals do not give hourly demand or pipe-level geometry. Access: The public dataset page links main data files and documentation through SDES DiDo. No data files were downloaded. Licence and cost: The provider states Licence Ouverte / Open Licence. Version details of that licence were not independently checked. Limitations: The commune denotes network location, which should not be equated automatically with every consumer’s location. Data completeness was not independently assessed. For simulation it supports local heat-demand calibration and district-energy baseline comparisons. Related resources: For comparison, model-pandapipes provides pipe-network modelling. This is a thematic link, not evidence of use in this study.
